feat(cdk): introduce HydrationTracker utility for SSR

Added `HydrationTracker` to monitor Angular app hydration status using `MutationObserver` with a configurable timeout and optional logging. Includes new DI token `HYDRATION_TRACKER_CONFIG_TOKEN` for customization and updated documentation with usage examples.

feat(demos): add VirtualView hydration demo

Introduced `VVHydrationDemo` component showcasing `rxVirtualView` with hydration tracking. Replaced `HydrationTrackerService` with `HydrationTracker` across the app and enhanced app configuration with `provideVirtualViewConfig`.

feat(template): add `assertInjector` utility from ngxtension

Introduced the `assertInjector` function to extend `assertInInjectionContext` with support for optional custom `Injector` and a runner function, enabling flexible usage within Angular's injection context.

feat(template): add  PLATFORM and `effectOnceIf` utilities

Introduced `effectOnceIf`, enabling conditional execution of effects in Angular's DI context with cleanup and flexible options. Added new `PLATFORM` token for platform-specific feature detection.

feat(template): add runtime enable/disable support for VirtualView

Introduced runtime support for enabling/disabling `RxVirtualView`, including new configuration options (`enabled`, `enableAfterHydration`) and reactive signals. Improved platform detection with `PLATFORM` token, updated resize observer and visibility logic for server/browser context compatibility, and adjusted content/placeholder lifecycle handling.

test(template): add tests for `enabled` in virtual views

Expanded test coverage for `RxVirtualView` to include scenarios where `enabled` is false and SSR hydration is involved. Added tests for `enabled` signal handling, placeholder/content strategies, and cache clearing on destruction.

docs(template): add SSR hydration guidelines for RxVirtualView

Expanded documentation for `RxVirtualView` to include guidance on using `enabled` and `enableAfterHydration` for SSR and client hydration. Added configuration examples for controlling virtual behavior during and after hydration.

fix(template): handle delayed content in VirtualView directive

Enhanced `#showContentWhenDisabled` to support cases where content availability is deferred, using `effectOnceIf` for reactive content rendering.

feat(template): add scrollMargin configuration to RxVirtualView

Introduced a new `scrollMargin` property in the `RxVirtualViewConfig` interface and updated the `RxVirtualViewObserver` directive to utilize this configuration. This enhancement allows for more precise observation of the virtual view within a specified scroll area, improving visibility handling in various scenarios.
feat(cdk): introduce PLATFORM token

refactor(template): replace usages with `PLATFORM` token

Simplified platform detection across `cdk` and `template` libraries by adopting the `PLATFORM` token. Removed redundant imports and logic related to `PLATFORM_ID` and `isPlatform*` functions. Updated `HydrationTracker` and `RxVirtualView` to streamline platform-specific handling for server and browser contexts.

fix(template): add virtual-view coverage + content-swap fix

Expand automated test coverage for the RxVirtualView package and add
SSR/e2e coverage via the ssr-hydration app:

- Shared test-utils (observer mocks, sync render strategy, TestBed
  builders, host components, fake ViewRef)
- Unit specs for cache, observer, content/placeholder directives,
  resize-observer, platform/effect utils, control-flow (@if/@for/@switch),
  CLS size-reservation, config permutations, and SSR/disabled state,
  including fast-check property tests
- Cypress e2e for apps/ssr-hydration (server-render + post-hydration)
  with an e2e target and a test-only after-hydration query-param hook

Fix RxVirtualView to support runtime content-template swaps while the
host element stays mounted (e.g. an @switch/@if case change). A single
content-sync effect now renders the active *rxVirtualViewContent whenever
it changes, covering the disabled/SSR initial render, deferred content
behind an inactive branch, and swaps in both enabled and disabled states.
Previously a case change on an already-visible card left it blank.
